root_idea.summary: The root centers on falling or coming down from a higher position to a lower one.
root_idea.development: From physical falling, the lexicon develops related uses for things that fall or are left behind, successive dropping, falling into error or regret, low status, falling short, and places or times of falling. It also yields nouns for fallen remnants and refuse.

senses.definition: To fall, fall down, drop, or descend from a higher to a lower place.
senses.usage_conditions: Includes active and passive Quranic constructions; the passive may be rendered “be made to fall.”

senses.definition: To fall into a trial, predicament, or adverse situation.
senses.usage_conditions: A figurative extension of falling, explicitly used with فِي الْفِتْنَةِ in the Quranic expression “they fell into the trial.”

senses.definition: In the idiom سُقِطَ فِي أَيْدِيهِمْ, to be overcome by regret, repent, or become confounded over what one has done.
senses.usage_conditions: This is an idiomatic Quranic construction, not a literal falling of an object into a hand.

senses.definition: To cause or undergo falling in successive portions; to drop or fall one part after another.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic construction of 19:25, the palm tree or its trunk is understood as dropping fresh dates successively upon Mary. The construction is associated with the reciprocal or middle-like development of causing and undergoing falling.

senses.definition: To make, cause, throw, or let something fall or drop.
senses.usage_conditions: The causative form may describe bringing something down from a higher place, including a celestial fragment or other object.
An active participle describing an object in the process of falling; in the Quranic occurrence it describes a fragment falling from the sky.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A child or fetus that comes from the womb abortively, immaturely, imperfectly, or dead but fully formed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The verb construction سَقَطَ الولدُ describes such an abortive delivery; سِقْطٌ names the child or fetus.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To slip, err, make a mistake, or fall into a fault.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of error in conduct and in the idiom سَقَطَ فِي يَدِهِ or related constructions apart from the specifically Quranic regret sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of the moon or a star, to set.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use based on its descending or disappearing from view.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To die.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use of falling.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To totter or become unsteady because of old age.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of an elderly person whose physical stability has declined.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To alight at, come to, or arrive at someone's abode.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The preposition إِلَى marks the destination or person approached.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To stumble upon, light upon, or find something sought or lost.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of finding a lost animal, a knowledgeable person, or another desired object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To descend from a position or fall from honor, rank, or esteem.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes falling from one's station and falling from another person's regard.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To drop off, fall behind, or remain in the rear.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension of falling behind other people or things.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To deviate from the road or proper route.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic extension from falling away from a path.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be dropped, left out, or omitted; for a person's name, to fall out of a register.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a mention, name, letter, or other item that is no longer included.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For one's power or capacity to fall short of attaining an objective.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional expression for failure to reach or accomplish an affair.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become null, void, annulled, or of no force; to lapse or fall away.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of claims, dues, conditions, laws, commands, rewards, punishments, good deeds, sins, and similar things.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For heat to fall, come, or befall; in another construction, to leave or depart from someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The lexicon records the apparently opposite directional constructions separately.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For discourse to pass from one interlocutor to another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of an exchange in which speech falls from each person to the other.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A fall, especially a violent fall.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun may also be used for a physical fall distinct from its figurative senses of error.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A slip, lapse, fault, wrong action, or bad word.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of an error in conduct, speech, or a saying that swerves from rectitude.

other_classical_meanings.definition: What falls from or is discarded by a thing and is regarded as refuse, worthless, paltry, or of little account.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of food, household goods, seasoning items, and the less-valued parts of a slaughtered animal.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A mistake or error in speech, reckoning, writing, or action.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun for an occurrence of error rather than the act of falling itself.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A disgraceful or shameful thing, vice, or fault.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative valuation of something as morally objectionable or dishonorable.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Evil or objectionable speech.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized expression for blameworthy words.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A seller of worthless, mean, or low-valued household goods and refuse.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The goods are those called سَقَطُ المَتَاعِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A spark or other particle that falls from a fire-drill or between the fire-sticks before the fire is fully produced.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized noun for material falling during the production of fire.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The slope, fall, or terminal edge of a tract of sand.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: It may denote where the sand ends, thins out, or reaches its furthest extent.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The visible edge or extremity of a cloud, appearing as though it were falling toward the earth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized meteorological and horizon expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The lower edge, strip, or side of a tent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term is derived from the notion of the tent's edge reaching or falling toward the ground.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A bird's wing, especially the part that drags along the ground.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression may refer to either wing or specifically its trailing portion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The two extremities of night: its beginning and its end.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A poetic expression for the limits or sides of the darkness of night.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Unripe dates that fall from palm trees.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The form may be treated as singular or plural in this specialized use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Dates brought from al-Yamāmah by those who travel there to obtain them.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A regional lexicalized use distinct from the general sense of fallen dates.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Hoarfrost or rime: dew that falls and freezes on the ground.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized weather term.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Snow.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A regional or extended weather sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Hail.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Also expressed as سَقِيطُ السَّحَابِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Dew that has fallen upon the ground.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A broader use than the specifically frozen form of dew.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Scattered or fallen particles, such as pearls or leaves.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The plural use may describe dispersed objects lying apart from one another.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A whelp or young animal.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A lexicalized noun, synonymous with جِرْوٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a horse, to outstrip or leave other horses behind.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use based on making others fall behind.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To converse alternately, or to tell someone information piece by piece.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The exchange proceeds successively, one speaker taking up after the other, or one person disclosing matters one by one.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a horse, to run in a slack, languid, or interrupted manner.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression may describe an uneven or repeatedly interrupted gait.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Repeated injury and bleeding of a horse's foot from stones during running.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized equestrian noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For a man to fail to attain the condition of the generous or noble.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative valuation of a person's character or standing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For a pregnant female or animal to cast or deliver a fetus abortively, immaturely, imperfectly, or dead but formed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The lexical evidence records variation over which female subjects and object complements are idiomatic.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To degrade someone from an honorable station.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A causative figurative extension of making someone fall from rank.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To drop, leave out, or omit a letter, word, name, or other item.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of textual omission and of removing a person's name from a register.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To annul, reject, or render null, void, or of no force; to abate an amount from a price.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of claims, dues, arguments, conditions, laws, commands, rewards, punishments, and similar matters.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To revile someone with evil speech.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized idiomatic construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To seek out another's mistake, or work to make someone err, lie, or reveal information.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The form can describe deliberate probing for an error or disclosure.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To obtain news or information little by little.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The information is received successively, one item after another.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To throw oneself upon something or someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: It may describe throwing oneself upon a person in order to protect him.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A fruit that falls before maturity.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The feminine form سَاقِطَةٌ and its plural سَوَاقِطُ are used in this substantivized sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A saying or word issuing from a speaker and taken up or heard by another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A proverbial metaphor of speech falling from the mouth and being picked up by its hearer.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Hanging down, pendent, or pendulous.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival extension from something falling or extending downward.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Tottering because of old age.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used as an epithet of an elderly person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Low, ignoble, base, vile, or lacking reputation in lineage or personal standing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: May describe a person or his ancestry and social standing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The refuse, rabble, or lowest and least regarded sort of people.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Also used of soldiers of whom no account is made.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Deficient in intellect, intelligence, or understanding; stupid.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative characterization of a person's mental capacity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Remaining behind or in the rear of others.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes a horse or person whose progress falls behind.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a thing, falling short of what is due, proper, or just.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative valuation of something as deficient or below the proper mean.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person who travels to al-Yamāmah to obtain dates or provisions.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A regional occupational or descriptive use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Small, low mountains close to the ground.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A plural geographic use based on low or fallen-looking elevations.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A seller of the less-valued parts of a slaughtered animal.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: These parts are collectively called سَقَطٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place or time of falling, dropping, or ending.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes the place where an object falls or where sand or another thing comes to an end; it can also denote a time such as the setting of a star.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Birthplace.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional expression literally referring to the place where one's head first came down or where one was born.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The time of a star's setting.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional temporal use, especially associated with the setting of an asterism.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A female that casts or delivers her fetus abortively or immaturely.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term describes the subject performing the abortive delivery.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A cause of someone's falling from the regard or esteem of people.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of an improper deed that lowers a person's reputation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A female accustomed to cast or deliver her young abortively or immaturely.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun of habitual tendency.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A fallen date.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression may be analyzed as equivalent to سَاقِطَةٌ or as “having falling”; the evidence preserves both analyses.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Walking in a slack or languid manner, as if repeatedly stumbling or throwing oneself down.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A descriptive participle for an unsteady gait.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A sword that cuts through what it strikes and falls or reaches beyond it, sometimes cleaving through to the ground.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized description of a sword whose cut passes through the object struck and extends beyond it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The small tubers forming the root of cyperus esculentus, or the cyperus plant itself.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized botanical noun, also identified with حَبُّ العَزِيزِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A door latch placed over the upper part of a door and falling onto it to fasten it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized object noun for a falling fastening mechanism.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Physical falling and successive falling are represented.
Quranic regret idiom and related error use.
Alighting or arriving at an abode.
Finding or lighting upon a sought object.
Descent and loss of rank or esteem.
Speech error is covered by the broader verb of slipping or erring.
Omission of a mention or registered name.
Form III successive causative falling is covered by the Quranic sense.
Relating material amid discourse is covered by the discourse construction.
Seeking or inducing error and disclosure.
Successive falling is covered by the Quranic Form III sense.
Throwing oneself upon something or someone.
Fetus or child lost from the womb.
Bird's wing or trailing wing portion.
The cited pottery sense is explicitly corrected to a different root and is not evidence for this root.
Sword that cuts through and falls beyond the object.
Saying issuing from a speaker and being taken up.
Fallings or coming of heat are covered by the heat construction.
The unit contains several distinct adjectival and social branches.
Falling short of the due mean.
Interrupted running is covered by the equestrian slack-running meaning.
Place or time of falling or ending.
Place where a thing ends is covered by the place-of-falling or ending meaning.
Female that casts a fetus abortively.
Fallen date and its alternative analysis.
The repentance idiom is represented by the Quranic Form I regret sense.

cautions: The Form III Quranic occurrence at 19:25 has variant grammatical and interpretive analyses concerning whether the palm tree or its trunk is the understood subject; the artifact preserves the shared successive-dropping sense without assigning a non-QAC verse location.
The expression سُقِطَ فِي أَيْدِيهِمْ is an idiom for regret or repentance and should not be read as an ordinary passive physical-fall construction.
Lane's bracketed Quran citation in its discussion of 19:25 is retained as lexical evidence only; the modern verse location used in the example comes from the independent QAC occurrence.
